name: higgsfield-ai-video-kk
description: Kazakh motion-design tutorial: generating a first AI video in Higgsfield (9:16, 1080×1920)

scripts.audio: node tools/prepare.mjs && node tools/render.mjs --sfx && python3 tools/audio.py
scripts.remux: npm run audio && ffmpeg -v error -y -i renders/higgsfield-ai-video-kk.mp4 -i build/mix.wav -map 0:v -map 1:a -c:v copy -c:a aac -b:a 192k -shortest -movflags +faststart out/remux.mp4 && mv out/remux.mp4 renders/higgsfield-ai-video-kk.mp4
